source.title: 歌手金莎个人资料, - 伤感说说吧
source.description:
Jin Sha Portrait

Jin Sha, also known by her stage name Kym, is a Chinese singer and actress born on March 14, 1983, in Shanghai. She first gained attention with her debut single "他不爱我" and has since built a career in both music and acting.

In this professional studio portrait, Jin Sha wears a delicate pale pink dress with feathered details. Her long, wavy brown hair frames her face, and her subtle makeup accentuates her eyes and lips. The neutral gray backdrop and soft lighting create an elegant and refined atmosphere, highlighting her poised demeanor.

source.title: 他不愛我 - song and lyrics by 金莎 | Spotify
source.description:
Cover Portrait of 金莎

The image features Chinese singer 金莎 leaning against a tree trunk, her long brown hair cascading over a white knit sweater. Soft natural light filters through the surrounding foliage, creating a serene and contemplative atmosphere. She looks off to the side with a thoughtful expression, set against a blurred background of greenery and hints of a garden.

This photograph serves as the cover art for her 2019 single "他不愛我," as displayed on Spotify. The minimalist composition and gentle lighting emphasize a quiet, introspective mood that complements the song’s emotional tone.

source.title: 金莎 music, videos, stats, and photos | Last.fm
source.description:
Portrait of Jin Sha

Jin Sha, better known by her stage name Kym, appears in a softly lit portrait wearing a white beaded top. Her long dark hair frames a thoughtful expression, accentuated by red lips and subtle makeup. A cluster of dried flowers in the foreground adds a natural, nostalgic touch to the composition.

Born in Shanghai in 1983, Jin Sha rose to fame through acting and music, debuting on television in 2002 and releasing her first album 空气 in 2005. This image captures her poised elegance and serene presence, reflecting the refined image that propelled her career in both acting and singing.

source.title: 星月神話 - song and lyrics by 金莎 | Spotify
source.description:
金莎 – 星月神話 (Legends)

Chinese pop artist 金莎 graces the cover of her 2010 single "星月神話," also known by its English title "Legends." The image features her in a fluffy, light-colored coat and a patterned top, standing against a luminous white backdrop. Her name appears in Chinese characters above the gold-scripted title "Legends," reflecting the song’s elegant and dreamy aesthetic.

Released in 2010, "星月神話" is available on Spotify, where this artwork serves as the official track image. The design emphasizes a soft, ethereal mood, aligning with the song’s lyrical themes and 金莎’s pop sensibility.
